summary: Tested live events visibility features: Live Now banners, Watch buttons for non-logged users, Stats buttons for completed games, and Team Game Log API. Most features are working correctly.

integration_issues.flow: Event Detail Modal Game Stats tab
integration_issues.issue: EventDetailModal with Game Stats tab is NOT used in current UnifiedEventsPage flow. Clicking event row opens EventCardPopup (simple card) instead. Stats button navigates to LiveGamePage. The Game Stats tab in EventDetailModal is only available when using EventsPage component directly.

The test teams (test-team-1, TEST_team_4d7067a7) have no game data, but Eagles team has game data via API. The game-log endpoint works correctly but teams with data don't appear in the dashboard Teams tab.
